resources.string: Real Liquid Glass Widgets for Android 17
Refractive liquid clock with morphing numerals, rising minute fill, and floating bubble seconds.
Live battery level liquid tank with waves, charging wattage, temperature, and rising bubbles.
On-device usage liquid ring and top 3 app droplets with direct launch.
Real-time weather with glass rain droplets, solar refraction glow, snow, and hourly bubbles.
Next 3 events in floating glass pills with a shrinking countdown droplet.
Album art refracted through thick glass with live liquid audio waves and glass controls.
Daily step goal water tank with bobbing droplet, distance, and calories.
Three sloshing liquid gauges for live CPU, RAM, and Storage usage.
Draining Pomodoro droplet timer and floating ink quick notes.
Liquid toggle bubbles for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Flashlight, DND, and instant app search.
